title: rosa spinosissima f. rosea
intro: Rosa spinosissima f. rosea, commonly known as the Alpine Rose or Dwarf Rose, is a shrub-like plant belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including wounds, inflammation, and menstrual disorders. The health benefits of Rosa spinosissima f. rosea include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties, making it an effective treatment for skin irritations and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
